summary: Allocates a range of a2 consecutive units in a bitmap tracker: grows the bitmap buffer and element array, records an element (cumulative counter low word + size a2) in the element array at index this[5], clears (marks used) a2 bits in the underlying bitmap byte array, increments the cumulative counter this[4] and element index this[5], returns the allocated slot index through *a3, and returns 1.

operations.description: Grow bitmap buffer via sub_59B490(this, a2) so the requested range fits.
Grow dynamic element array via GrowDynamicElementArray(this) so the next element index is within capacity.
Write the low word of the cumulative counter (field 0x10) as the first word of element entry at this[2] + 4*this[5] in the element array (field 0x8), indexed by this[5] (field 0x14).
Write a2 as the size word at element entry this[2] + 4*this[5] + 2.
Clear (mark used) a2 bits in the bitmap byte array at *this (field 0x0): for each bit index v4 from the recorded cumulative counter to v4+a2, AND out bit (v4 & 7) in byte (v4 >> 3).
Output the allocated slot index: *a3 = this[5] (element index, field 0x14).
Increment cumulative allocated-unit counter this[4] (field 0x10) by a2.
Increment element index / allocation count this[5] (field 0x14) by 1.
Return 1 (allocation always succeeds from caller perspective).
